title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Onboarding and Offboarding Procedure > Offboarding

The manager notifies HR on or before the last working day.All access is revoked within 4 hours of the person's exit time.Shared secrets that the person had access to are rotated within 2 business days.The company laptop is returned, and the device is wiped within 3 business days.Offboarding is recorded in the audit log and checked in the next quarterly access review.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Access Control Policy > Emergency access

In an incident, the on-call engineer may take emergency production access for up to 2 hours without prior approval. The Engineering Manager must approve it retrospectively within 24 hours.
